login.title: Sign in to Verisure
login.hint: Use the e-mail and password of your Verisure account (the same as in the My Verisure app). Tip: create a separate Verisure user for Homey so its actions are easy to tell apart.

mfa.hint_phone: Verisure sent a verification code to your phone by SMS.
mfa.hint_email: Verisure sent a verification code to your e-mail.
mfa.wait: Wait __seconds__ s before requesting another code.

installation.hint: Choose the installation to add devices from.

repair.subtitle: Sign in again to reconnect
repair.done: Signed in. Your Verisure devices will reconnect within a minute.

error.invalid_auth: Verisure rejected the e-mail or password.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Check it, or request a new one.
error.rate_limited: Verisure is limiting sign-in attempts for this account. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.session_lost: The sign-in session expired. Go back and sign in again.
error.no_installations: No installations were found for this account.
error.installation_missing: This installation is not available to the signed-in account.

device.missing: Verisure no longer reports this device.

camera.capture_timeout: The camera did not deliver a picture in time.

settings.title: Verisure accounts
settings.subtitle: Accounts this Homey is signed in to.
settings.none: Not signed in to any Verisure account. Add a Verisure device to sign in.
settings.trusted: Homey is a trusted device (skips the verification code)
settings.confirm:
Sign out of __email__?

Homey is removed as a trusted device at Verisure and the stored password is deleted. The __devices__ device(s) of this account stop updating until you open one and choose Repair, or delete them.
settings.done_revoked: Signed out. Homey is no longer a trusted device and the stored login is deleted.
settings.done: Signed out and the stored login is deleted.
settings.done_local: The stored login is deleted, but Verisure could not be reached to end the session (__error__). You can remove Homey under trusted devices on My Pages.
settings.note: To sign in again, open any Verisure device and choose Repair. Removing all devices of an account does not sign it out — use Sign out.
settings.signed_out_device: Signed out of Verisure. Open the device and choose Repair to sign in again.
settings.unknown_account: That account is not signed in.

arm_code.invalid: Enter the Verisure code as 4–8 digits.
